text: Home About us Hotel Rooms Services Restaurant Wedding Conference Other services Resort News Contac us Address: 25 Quang Trung Street, Thanh Vinh Ward, Nghe An Province Reservation Line: 0964 36 39 68 WELCOME TO SAI GON KIM LIEN HOTEL Saigon Kim Lien Hotel – a landmark built to commemorate the 100th birthday of President Ho Chi Minh, stands as a destination rich in history and culture in the heart of Nghe An. As a 4-star hotel, Saigon Kim Lien offers 80 well-appointed rooms, 3 restaurants, 2 multifunctional conference halls, a lush garden, bar, and modern leisure facilities. It is also a trusted venue for hosting major events, conferences, seminars, and professional programs, meeting the diverse needs of corporate and organizational clients. At Saigon Kim Lien, guests will enjoy an elegant yet cozy atmosphere, attentive and professional service, and a diverse culinary journey featuring Asian, European, and Nghe An specialties. In particular, the hotel is also an ideal venue for weddings, blending modern style with traditional charm to create truly memorable moments on your special day.
